meta.parties: In Re the Estate of Dingirala

rules.statement: A document executed by a person, even if somewhat in the nature of a deed, can be given effect as a testamentary disposition where it is clear that the testator intended it to take effect after their death.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where a document executed by a person was somewhat in the nature of a deed, but where it was clear that he intended that it should take effect as a testamentary disposition, the Court gave effect to the document as a last will."
